css: .thermal-receipt{width:80mm;max-width:80mm;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-size:11px;color:#000;margin:0;padding:0}.receipt-header{text-align:center;margin-bottom:6px}.receipt-logo{max-height:38px;max-width:55mm;margin-bottom:4px}.shop-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;margin-top:2px}.shop-info{font-size:9.5px;line-height:1.35;margin-top:2px}.receipt-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;margin-top:5px;text-transform:uppercase}.receipt-info{font-size:10px;line-height:1.45}.receipt-info div,.summary-row,.payment-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}.receipt-info span{font-weight:600}.receipt-info strong{text-align:right}.receipt-items{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:10px}.receipt-items th{text-align:left;border-bottom:1px dashed #000;padding:3px 0}.receipt-items td{padding:3px 0;vertical-align:top}.receipt-items th:nth-child(n+2),.receipt-items td:nth-child(n+2){text-align:right}.receipt-items td:first-child{width:42%;word-break:break-word}.receipt-summary,.payment-breakdown{font-size:10.5px}.summary-row,.payment-row{padding:2px 0}.grand-total{font-size:14px;font-weight:900;padding:4px 0}.section-title{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:3px;text-transform:uppercase}.fbr-block{text-align:center}.fbr-qr{display:block;width:25.4mm;height:25.4mm;margin:5px auto}.fbr-note{font-size:9px;line-height:1.3;margin-top:3px}.receipt-footer{text-align:center;font-size:10px;margin-top:8px}.thanks{font-weight:800}.powered{margin-top:3px;font-size:9px}hr{border:none;border-top:1px dashed #000;margin:6px 0}@media print{@page{size:80mm auto;margin:3mm}body{margin:0;padding:0}}
html:
{% set brand = frappe.get_doc('Ledgix Brand Settings') %}{% set seller_name_snapshot = frappe.db.get_value('Ledgix Sale', doc.name, 'seller_name_snapshot') %}{% set seller_address_snapshot = frappe.db.get_value('Ledgix Sale', doc.name, 'seller_address_snapshot') %}{% set seller_phone_snapshot = frappe.db.get_value('Ledgix Sale', doc.name, 'seller_phone_snapshot') %}{% set seller_ntn_snapshot = frappe.db.get_value('Ledgix Sale', doc.name, 'seller_ntn_cnic_snapshot') %}{% set seller_strn_snapshot = frappe.db.get_value('Ledgix Sale', doc.name, 'seller_strn_snapshot') %}{% set seller_name = seller_name_snapshot or brand.legal_business_name or brand.brand_name or 'Ledgix' %}{% set seller_address = seller_address_snapshot or brand.business_address or '' %}{% set seller_phone = seller_phone_snapshot or brand.business_phone or '' %}{% set seller_ntn = seller_ntn_snapshot or brand.ntn or '' %}{% set seller_strn = seller_strn_snapshot or brand.strn or '' %}{% set fbr_qr = get_fbr_qr_data_uri(doc.fbr_invoice_number) if doc.fbr_invoice_number else '' %}
{% if brand.full_logo %}{% endif %}
{{ seller_name }}
{% if seller_address %}
{{ seller_address }}
{% endif %}
{% if seller_phone %}{{ seller_phone }}{% endif %}{% if seller_ntn %} · NTN {{ seller_ntn }}{% endif %}{% if seller_strn %} · STRN {{ seller_strn }}{% endif %}
Sales Receipt
Invoice:{{ doc.invoice_number or doc.name }}
Date:{{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.sale_date, 'dd-MM-yyyy') }}
Customer:{{ doc.buyer_name_snapshot or doc.customer or 'Walk-in Customer' }}
Cashier:{{ doc.owner }}
Shift:{{ doc.pos_shift or '-' }}
{% for item in doc.items %}{% endfor %}
ItemQtyRateTotal
{{ item.item }}{{ item.quantity }}{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(item.rate or 0) }}{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(item.amount or 0) }}
Subtotal:{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.subtotal_before_discount or doc.total_amount or 0) }}
Discount:{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.discount_amount or 0) }}
Tax:{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.tax_amount or 0) }}
Total:{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.grand_total or doc.total_amount or 0) }}
Paid:{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.paid_amount or 0) }}
Change:{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.change_amount or 0) }}
{% if doc.payments %}
Payment Breakdown
{% for payment in doc.payments %}
{{ payment.payment_method }}{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(payment.amount or 0) }}
{% endfor %}
{% endif %}{% if doc.fbr_invoice_number %}
FBR Digital Invoice
{% if fbr_qr %}{% endif %}
FBR Invoice No:{{ doc.fbr_invoice_number }}
